correctness.rationale: Two exact definitions of compatibility agree on every pair of the 64 ambient words. Exhaustive maximal-clique enumeration and an independent fixed-size clique enumeration both certify maximum size 12 and exactly 30 maxima. A separate constructive generation from all 15 perfect matchings and two parity halves produces exactly the same 30 codes. The verifier also checks the universal weight distribution, 16 free points, the S_6 orbit, and stabilizer order 24.

value.rationale: The length-six optimum is a canonical exact parameter reused in later F-optimal/two-stage Z-channel work. A full equality classification explains the geometry behind the representative optimum, gives the exact number of labeled maximizers, shows all are coordinate equivalent, and proves every optimum has the free-point optimum 16.
